title: learn_me pack manifest
description: The root inventory of a learn_me pack repo. Apps that register pack endpoints read this to know which packs they can import, under what license, by subject/tag/age. Part of the learn_me pack spec.

spec.description: Fixed marker so a consumer can tell a manifest from a deck document.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Bump when the shape changes; consumers gate on it.

packs.description: One entry per pack in the repo, in deck-id order.

id.description: The deck id (the DeckDocument `deck` field). Stable identity; re-import reuses cards.

file.description: Path to the pack JSON, relative to the repo root.

subject.description: Primary subject (e.g. amateur-radio, anatomy). Free-form slug; consumers group by it.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering (e.g. fcc, ncvec, license-exam, us).

age.description: Recommended minimum age or age band, free-form (e.g. 16+, adult).

license.description: SPDX license id of the pack content (the DeckDocument `source_license`).

cards.description: Number of cards in the pack.

source_url.description: URL of the source corpus, when one is known.
